neighbours.label: The '-ography / -ographer / -ographic' piece completing 'cartography' (map-making: cart|ography, cart|ographer, cart|ographic); other '-ography' words (oceanography, choreography) and map-making without the word stay quiet.
fire: Medieval cartographers filled blank spaces with monsters.
The library holds a fine collection of early cartography.
She trained as a cartographer in Vienna.
The cartographic survey took ten years.
Cartographers marked the new border in red.
He wrote a history of Chinese cartography.
quiet: Medieval mapmakers filled blank spaces with monsters.
The library holds a fine collection of early maps.
She trained as a choreographer in Vienna.
The geological survey took ten years.
Surveyors marked the new border in red.
He wrote a history of Chinese lithography.

notes: Card: 'ography' / 'ographic' / 'ographer' pieces of cart|ography (cart⟦ography⟧ still relies on...; cart⟦ograph⟧ier), and Arabic 'ب'. Tokenizer: cart|ography, cart|ographer, cart|ographers, cart|ographic; ocean|ography, chore|ographer, lith|ography also split. Exploratory probe: cartography 0.93, cartographer 0.57, oceanography 0.001; 'medieval maps' 0.004. So the near misses include other split -ography words.
